title: data/precursors/*.json source files

_meta.description: Free-form metadata (source URLs, scrapedAt timestamp, etc.)

winners.description: Optional. For ceremonies with tied/co-winners in a single category (DD 67th+ gender-neutral performance categories, occasional design ties), list ALL winning shows. Enrich credits each show with a win. `winner` is the legacy single-string equivalent. If both are present, `winners` takes precedence. Tied winners must still appear in `nominees`.

winnerPersonName.description: Optional. For acting categories where `winner` stores the SHOW name (Cats: The Jellicle Ball etc.), this holds the WINNING PERFORMER's name. enrich-awards-with-precursors.js writes it into the show's winnerNames map so chip-render attributes to the right performer.

winnerEntries.description: Optional. Tie co-winners with explicit per-winner production pairing, emitted by the year-page scraper when a category has multiple winners joined by ' and ' (e.g. DD 70th Lead Performance in a Musical: Joshua Henry + Caissie Levy, both Ragtime; Lead Play: Lithgow/Giant + Manville/Oedipus). enrich attributes each person to their paired show directly — no nominee-adjacency or Tony fallback. `winnerPersonName`/`winner` mirror the first entry for back-compat.

noAward.description: True when the ceremony gave no award this year in this category (e.g. NYDCC Best Musical 2018, 2021, 2023).

oneOf.title: Pulitzer shape — array of {year, winner, finalists[]} (title-keyed)
Pulitzer historic shape — array of {year, winnerId?, finalistIds?[]} (showId-keyed; at least one of winnerId/finalistIds required)
